audited_source_corrections.action: Described the worked tableau as proving its displayed formula Box A implies Box Diamond A, rather than calling that different formula axiom 5.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: Axiom 5 is Diamond A implies Box Diamond A throughout the book, while both the tableau root and the following displayed formula use Box A implies Box Diamond A.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் எடுத்துக்காட்டு அட்டவணை மரம் உண்மையில் நிறுவும் காட்டப்பட்ட வாய்பாட்டையே பெயரிடுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Calling the displayed formula axiom 5; replacing the root and rebuilding the proof of actual axiom 5.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The existing proof tree is valid for the displayed S5 theorem; correcting its description preserves the proof while avoiding a false axiom identification.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the prose now name exactly the formula at the tableau root without identifying it as axiom 5?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed both 4r proof evaluations from the ill-typed f(sigma).n to f(sigma.n).
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The prefix interpretation f maps the whole prefix sigma.n to a world; appending .n to the world value f(sigma) is undefined.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இரு 4r நிறுவல்களிலும்~$f(\sigma.n)$ என்ற முன்னொட்டின் பொருள்கோள் மதிப்பைப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Treating model worlds as sequences without any stated structure; changing the definition of prefix interpretation.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The premise is evaluated at prefix sigma.n and the definition supplies exactly the world f(sigma.n).
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Do both 4r cases evaluate their premises at f(sigma.n)?
